_about: DRQN candidate: R2D2-style learner (Acme) with Arnold acting/replay settings; same encoder + map.
_drqn_source: Acme r2d2 config.py: burn_in 40, trace 80, period 40, n 5, target 2500, IS 0.6, priority exp 0.9, max_priority_weight 0.9; Arnold: replay 1M, gamma 0.99, sampled ~8x, eps 1->0.1 over 1M; grad clip 10 (DRQN App. C: LSTM gradients clipped to ten); lr 1e-4 (Acme default is 1e-3; R2D2 paper unverified)
_episode_ticks_source: docs/CONTRACT.md §5: episode cap 2,100-4,200 ticks depending on the map; sampled per episode
